title: 发现风险，不等于选对协作协议
coreProposition: Detecting risk opens consideration but does not select a collaboration protocol or authorize its cost.
synopsis: Controlled mathematics evidence separates failure prediction from protocol-specific value and budget admission; uncertainty cannot justify automatic expensive escalation.
scene: An amber warning stands on the stem of a cobalt glass fork, with its two equal branches still visibly unselected.
titlePromise: Show that warning and choosing a direction are different decisions.
readerProblem: A high risk score is mistaken for evidence that a particular collaboration is useful.
dominantSubject: One regular cobalt glass forked direction symbol
visibleResult: Both candidate directions remain equal and unselected
colorScale: Cobalt is the two equal candidate directions; smaller amber warning is the risk input, subordinate to the choice.
composition: Single forked sculptural symbol center frame on pale floor; amber triangle at incoming stem; bright ivory background.
materialsLightingPalette: Thick cobalt optical glass, subtle silver bevels, small amber warning triangle, high-key daylight.
sanitizedPrompt: Create a sophisticated 16:9 editorial 3D conceptual illustration in a bright ivory architectural space. The dominant subject is one substantial freestanding forked-direction symbol crafted from translucent cobalt-blue optical glass: a single straight upright stem divides symmetrically into two clean equal diagonal arrow branches pointing upper-left and upper-right. Precise straight edges, consistent thickness, modest polished bevels and fine silver edge accents give the familiar symbol an orderly engineered geometry. A smaller upright amber-glass warning triangle containing one simple silver exclamation mark rests against the lower incoming stem, beneath the split. Both blue branches have exactly equal brightness, size and material, expressing that detecting a warning leaves the direction undecided. The entire fork and warning form one compact sculptural group centered in the wide frame, occupying two-thirds of the image. Pale floor reflections, luminous cobalt refractions, restrained amber, generous clean margins, bright diffuse daylight, softly receding ivory architecture and polished high-end technology editorial rendering.
